desc: A nuclear-capable B-52 bomber base that in March 2026 became the focal point of the most serious domestic incursion episode yet recorded. On 9 March 2026 the base raised force protection to FPCON Charlie and issued a shelter-in-place order after reports of an unmanned aerial system over the installation; Capt. Hunter Rininger, chief of public affairs, confirmed the report and the FAA's involvement. Reporting later that month described multiple waves of 12 to 15 drones over sensitive areas including the flight line, with non-commercial signal characteristics, resistance to jamming, and flight patterns suggesting the operators were probing security responses - all of it occurring after the launch of Operation Epic Fury, the US bombing campaign against Iran flown in part by Barksdale's B-52s. Only one Anduril counter-drone fly-away kit was fielded at the time and the bombers remained largely exposed on the flightline. Barksdale is the point where the fourteen-month-old federal position that drone sightings were hobbyists and misidentified stars became untenable.
